critical_code_review_comments: telephony.make_call now POSTs to /callcontrol/{DN}/makecall first (DN-level Route Point origination) and only falls back to device-level when registered devices exist — correct ordering and matches 3CX v20 Route Point semantics.

telephony.test_connection uses GET /callcontrol to confirm controllability of the DN and surfaces is_route_point/dn_type — strong signal to admins that the configured DN is appropriate for automated outbound (no human leg).

routes.dial_contact logs call.destination as the CLIENT number (not the DN), and persists provider='3cx' + callid → enables accurate call history and rules out the prior regression at the data layer too.
_parse_makecall is defensive against both flat and {result:{...}} 3CX response shapes; good resilience.

Minor: _get_token uses a process-global cache keyed by base_url+client_id; in a multi-tenant deployment with many orgs this is fine, but consider adding a TTL sweep to avoid unbounded growth over time (low priority).
